messages:
Ajay K: FYI scheduling a maintenance window Thu 2026-04-02 02:00-05:00 UTC for the saturn GPU pool (NIC firmware + kernel patch). Plan is siloed rack drains, 6 nodes per cohort, ~10-12m per cohort including preflight checks. No hosted API downtime expected; Dedicated capacity may be shifted briefly.

Maya (infra): +1. Current spare capacity in saturn is ~18%. We can shift low-priority tenants to gradient-pool and enable autoscale-burst. We should update the runbook and add a quick rollback path.

Sasha P: Strong rec to run a 2-rack canary in AZ3 first. Also: after each cohort, do KV/prefix cache warmup (5m). On any regressions we'll flip routing to the cached model variant and reduce batch-size.

Leah (finance): Quick cost check — if we backfill cross-region to us-west, estimate ~1.2TB egress. At $0.09/GB that's ~\$108. Can we avoid cross-region egress except for emergency overflow?

Ajay K: We will prefer intra-region backfill; cross-region only if capacity > threshold. Limit burst windows to 30m to cap egress. If cost owners want exact numbers I'll run a detailed calc and share post-run.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260402-1 created for scheduled maintenance. Start ETA 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. PagerDuty notified.

Dom (eng-platform): Make sure console rollout settings: canary=2, max_unavailable=1. Update route policy: route_by=latency, allow_fallback=true, cost_threshold=0.5 (so we avoid high-cost cross-region unless necessary).

Maya (infra): Preflight checklist (high-level): verify drain readiness, confirm backfill targets, confirm autoscale-burst enabled, ensure alerting hooks active. Drain command we will use: 

```
kubectl drain gpu-node-{{id}} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=600
```

Post-drain warmup: 

```
redwoodctl warmup --pool saturn --prefix-cache --duration 300
```

Sasha P: We'll watch latency and token-level cost. Abort and rollback cohort if 95th pct token latency > 2x baseline or error rate spike > 0.5%. Also keep an eye on model quality regressions for top-ten prompt evals.

Ajay K: Timeline draft: 02:00 AZ3 cohort A (2 racks canary), 02:30 AZ3 cohort B, 03:00 AZ1 cohort A, 03:30 AZ1 cohort B, 04:00 AZ2 sweep. Final verification by 04:50; close window 05:00. I'll post status updates in this thread during the run.

Leah (finance): OK. Please tag me in the post-run cost + egress report.

Maya (infra): Adding note to runbook: explicitly log per-cohort egress and autoscale events, include snapshot of per-route token cost.

Ajay K: Will do. If anyone sees unexpected capacity pressure before Thu, flag here so we can reschedule. Thanks all :thumbsup:
